captions.caption: Man in red hoodie and teal cap stands by a Flexi-coil air cart.
Man walks beside the large tire of the agricultural machine.
Man inspects the side of the 3850 air cart model.
Man views the rear of the cart outdoors on a cloudy day.
Man points to the frame where a tank is missing.
Close-up shows a newly installed stainless steel tank section.
Man touches the rim of the tank component.
Man turns back to the camera to explain the assembly.
Man begins walking across the dirt lot away from the machine.
Man walks toward the camera, discussing tank installation.
Man continues walking through the farm yard.
Man gestures while walking, mentioning other workers.
Man walks past snowy patches in the farm yard.
Man maintains pace, talking about work difficulty.
Man looks sideways, noting the slow progress of the job.
Man describes the overhaul like pulling a car engine.
Man walks toward a blue workshop building.
Man emphasizes the tedious nature of the machine work.
Man approaches the blue metal building door.
Man mentions building a "bulletproof" air cart.
Man reaches the entrance of the blue workshop.
Man looks at the camera before entering the building.
Man opens the door to go inside the shop.
Man enters the workshop, transitioning indoors.
Man approaches a plastic-wrapped object in the shop.
Man touches the white plastic wrapping on a tank.
Man begins tearing the plastic wrap off the equipment.
Man pulls large sheets of plastic from the tank.
More plastic is removed, revealing black metal parts.
Man and another worker unpack the new equipment.
Workers clear away white protective wrap from the tank.
Worker in blue coveralls removes cardboard and plastic.
Man in red hoodie speaks to the camera about missing parts.
Man explains the shortage of components for the build.
Man stands in the workshop with large tanks behind him.
Man continues discussing missing tools and parts.
Man gestures toward the shop equipment while talking.
Man looks around the active workshop environment.
Man says suppliers hadn't seen the equipment in person.
Man smiles while discussing logistical errors.
Man shifts position, still talking about missing pieces.
Man looks off-camera at other workers in the shop.
Man explains the situation between two large grey tanks.
Man adjusts his safety glasses while speaking.
Man emphasizes getting the project back on track.
Man in green cap and grey hoodie appears on camera.
Man stands before a massive air cart with a grey tank.
Man points to the secured tank on the air cart.
Man explains the first tank installation is complete.
Man announces they are ready for the next tank.
Man describes the plan to move the cart out.
Man gestures toward the large agricultural machinery.
Man mentions using a skid steer for the move.
Man continues his progress update in the workshop.
Man turns his head, discussing the machinery shift.
Man looks at the camera, explaining next steps.
Skid steer is visible in the background of the shop.
Man concludes his update on tank installation.
Man prepares to start moving the large equipment.
Man walks toward the back of the workshop cart.
